151: class FeatureExtractor:
152:     """
153:     Converts a list of IMUSnapshot into a fixed-length 38-feature vector.
154: 
155:     Index  Description
156:     ─────  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
157:      0-17  Per-channel mean/std/max_abs for gx,gy,gz,ax,ay,az   (6×3=18)
158:     18-21  Gyro magnitude mean/std/max/range                      (4)
159:       22   Dominant gyro angle atan2(mean_gy, mean_gz)            (1)
160:     23-24  Gyro RMS, accel RMS (energy)                           (2)
161:     25-27  Jerk: abs mean of frame-to-frame diffs for gx,gy,gz   (3)
162:     28-29  Zero crossings: gz, gy                                 (2)
163:       30   Peak timing fraction (peak_idx / (n-1))                (1)
164:     31-33  Signed area: sum(gz), sum(gy), sum(gx)                 (3)
165:       34   Dominant axis ratio abs(gz)/(abs(gz)+abs(gy)+eps)      (1)
166:     35-36  Euler roll mean, pitch mean                            (2)
167:       37   Gyro magnitude at peak frame                           (1)
168:     ─────  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
169:            Total: 38
170:     """
171: 
172:     N_FEATURES = 38
173: 
174:     def extract(self, window: List[IMUSnapshot]) -> Optional[List[float]]:
175:         if len(window) < 3:
176:             return None
177: 
178:         n = len(window)
179:         gx_v = [s.gx for s in window]
180:         gy_v = [s.gy for s in window]
181:         gz_v = [s.gz for s in window]
182:         ax_v = [s.ax for s in window]
183:         ay_v = [s.ay for s in window]
184:         az_v = [s.az for s in window]
185: 
186:         feats: List[float] = []
187: 
188:         # Per-channel stats: mean, std, max_abs  (6 × 3 = 18)
189:         for vals in (gx_v, gy_v, gz_v, ax_v, ay_v, az_v):
190:             mean = sum(vals) / n
191:             std  = math.sqrt(sum((v - mean) ** 2 for v in vals) / n)
192:             mabs = max(abs(v) for v in vals)
193:             feats.extend([mean, std, mabs])
194: 
195:         # Gyro magnitude stats  (4)
196:         gmags   = [math.sqrt(s.gx**2 + s.gy**2 + s.gz**2) for s in window]
197:         gm_mean = sum(gmags) / n
198:         gm_std  = math.sqrt(sum((v - gm_mean) ** 2 for v in gmags) / n)
199:         gm_max  = max(gmags)
200:         gm_rng  = gm_max - min(gmags)
201:         feats.extend([gm_mean, gm_std, gm_max, gm_rng])
202: 
203:         # Dominant gyro angle  (1)
204:         mean_gy = sum(gy_v) / n
205:         mean_gz = sum(gz_v) / n
206:         feats.append(math.atan2(mean_gy, mean_gz))
207: 
208:         # Energy: gyro RMS, accel RMS  (2)
209:         feats.append(math.sqrt(sum(s.gx**2 + s.gy**2 + s.gz**2 for s in window) / n))
210:         feats.append(math.sqrt(sum(s.ax**2 + s.ay**2 + s.az**2 for s in window) / n))
211: 
212:         # ── Temporal features ──────────────────────────────────────────────
213: 
214:         # Jerk: abs mean of adjacent-frame differences  (3)
215:         if n > 1:
216:             jerk_gx = sum(abs(gx_v[i] - gx_v[i-1]) for i in range(1, n)) / (n - 1)
217:             jerk_gy = sum(abs(gy_v[i] - gy_v[i-1]) for i in range(1, n)) / (n - 1)
218:             jerk_gz = sum(abs(gz_v[i] - gz_v[i-1]) for i in range(1, n)) / (n - 1)
219:         else:
220:             jerk_gx = jerk_gy = jerk_gz = 0.0
221:         feats.extend([jerk_gx, jerk_gy, jerk_gz])
222: 
223:         # Zero crossings: gz, gy  (2)
224:         feats.append(float(sum(1 for i in range(1, n) if gz_v[i-1] * gz_v[i] < 0)))
225:         feats.append(float(sum(1 for i in range(1, n) if gy_v[i-1] * gy_v[i] < 0)))
226: 
227:         # Peak timing fraction  (1)
228:         peak_idx = max(range(n), key=lambda i: gmags[i])
229:         feats.append(peak_idx / max(n - 1, 1))
230: 
231:         # Signed area (integral approx)  (3)
232:         feats.append(sum(gz_v))
233:         feats.append(sum(gy_v))
234:         feats.append(sum(gx_v))
235: 
236:         # Dominant axis ratio  (1)
237:         eps = 1e-6
238:         feats.append(abs(mean_gz) / (abs(mean_gz) + abs(mean_gy) + eps))
239: 
240:         # Euler orientation means  (2)
241:         feats.append(sum(s.euler_roll  for s in window) / n)
242:         feats.append(sum(s.euler_pitch for s in window) / n)
243: 
244:         # Gyro magnitude at peak frame  (1)
245:         feats.append(gmags[peak_idx])
246: 
247:         assert len(feats) == self.N_FEATURES, \
248:             f"Feature count mismatch: expected {self.N_FEATURES}, got {len(feats)}"
249:         return feats

254: class IntentLabeler:
255:     """
256:     Labels a gesture by the direction from the blade to the nearest fruit.
257:     Rejects ambiguous cases: diagonal directions and trajectory-fruit disagreements.
258:     """
259: 
260:     DIRECTIONS = ("right", "left", "up", "down")
261: 
262:     @staticmethod
263:     def label(
264:         blade_xy: Tuple[float, float],
265:         fruits_xy: List[Tuple[float, float]],
266:         blade_history: Optional[List[Tuple[float, float]]] = None,
267:         ambiguity_margin: float = 0.25,
268:     ) -> Optional[str]:
269:         """
270:         Returns direction label or None if:
271:           - No fruits present
272:           - Direction is too diagonal (ambiguous intent)
273:           - Blade trajectory clearly disagrees with fruit direction
274:         """
275:         if not fruits_xy:
276:             return None
277: 
278:         bx, by = blade_xy
279:         nearest = min(fruits_xy, key=lambda f: math.hypot(f[0] - bx, f[1] - by))
280:         dx = nearest[0] - bx
281:         dy = nearest[1] - by
282: 
283:         abs_dx, abs_dy = abs(dx), abs(dy)
284:         total = abs_dx + abs_dy
285:         if total < 1e-6:
286:             return None
287: 
288:         # Require one axis to dominate (rejects diagonals)
289:         dom_frac = max(abs_dx, abs_dy) / total
290:         if dom_frac < (0.5 + ambiguity_margin):
291:             return None
292: 
293:         direction = ("right" if dx > 0 else "left") if abs_dx >= abs_dy \
294:                     else ("down" if dy > 0 else "up")
295: 
296:         # Validate against blade trajectory: reject if blade moved opposite to fruit
297:         if blade_history and len(blade_history) >= 3:
298:             traj_dx = blade_history[-1][0] - blade_history[0][0]
299:             traj_dy = blade_history[-1][1] - blade_history[0][1]
300:             if math.hypot(traj_dx, traj_dy) > 20:
301:                 # Only reject if strictly opposite, allow orthogonal/arcing
302:                 if direction == "right" and traj_dx < -40: return None
303:                 if direction == "left"  and traj_dx >  40: return None
304:                 if direction == "down"  and traj_dy < -40: return None
305:                 if direction == "up"    and traj_dy >  40: return None
306: 
307:         return direction

312: class SmartRecorder:
313:     """
314:     Records event-centered gesture windows with quality guards.
315:     Tracks class balance and blade trajectory for context-aware labeling.
316:     """
317: 
318:     def __init__(self, buffer: GestureBuffer, extractor: FeatureExtractor):
319:         self._buf           = buffer
320:         self._extractor     = extractor
321:         self._last_rec      = 0.0
322:         self._blade_history: deque = deque(maxlen=10)
323:         self._class_counts: Dict[str, int] = {d: 0 for d in IntentLabeler.DIRECTIONS}
324:         self.recordings: List[Dict] = []
325: 
326:     def update_blade_history(self, blade_xy: Tuple[float, float]) -> None:
327:         self._blade_history.append(blade_xy)
328: 
329:     @property
330:     def class_balance_ok(self) -> bool:
331:         counts = [v for v in self._class_counts.values() if v > 0]
332:         if len(counts) < 2:
333:             return True
334:         return max(counts) / min(counts) < BALANCE_WARN_RATIO
335: 
336:     @property
337:     def class_counts(self) -> Dict[str, int]:
338:         return dict(self._class_counts)
339: 
340:     def try_record(
341:         self,
342:         gs,
343:         blade_xy: Tuple[float, float],
344:         fruits_xy: List[Tuple[float, float]],
345:         session_id: str = "",
346:         mode: str = "standard",
347:         profile: GestureProfile = PROFILE_STANDARD,
348:     ) -> bool:
349:         """Attempt to record an event-centered gesture window. Returns True if recorded."""
350: 
351:         if not fruits_xy:
352:             return False
353: 
354:         now = time.monotonic()
355:         if now - self._last_rec < profile.cooldown_secs:
356:             return False
357: 
358:         gyro_mag = math.sqrt(gs.abs_gx**2 + gs.abs_gy**2 + gs.abs_gz**2)
359:         if gyro_mag < profile.motion_mag_min:
360:             return False
361: 
362:         window = self._buf.snapshot()
363:         if len(window) < 6:
364:             return False
365: 
366:         mags   = [math.sqrt(s.gx**2 + s.gy**2 + s.gz**2) for s in window]
367:         mean_m = sum(mags) / len(mags)
368:         std_m  = math.sqrt(sum((v - mean_m) ** 2 for v in mags) / len(mags))
369:         if std_m > profile.erratic_std_max:
370:             return False
371: 
372:         # Event-centering: extract window centered on motion peak
373:         peak_idx = max(range(len(mags)), key=lambda i: mags[i])
374:         half     = EVENT_FRAMES // 2
375:         start    = max(0, peak_idx - half)
376:         end      = min(len(window), start + EVENT_FRAMES)
377:         start    = max(0, end - EVENT_FRAMES)
378:         centered = window[start:end]
379: 
380:         features = self._extractor.extract(centered)
381:         if features is None:
382:             return False
383: 
384:         label = IntentLabeler.label(
385:             blade_xy, fruits_xy,
386:             blade_history=list(self._blade_history),
387:             ambiguity_margin=profile.ambiguity_margin
388:         )
389:         if label is None:
390:             return False
391: 
392:         quality = {"gyro_peak": mags[peak_idx], "gyro_mean": mean_m, "gyro_std": std_m}
393: 
394:         self.recordings.append({
395:             "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
396:             "algorithm":  "RandomForest",
397:             "features":   features,
398:             "label":      label,
399:             "time":       now,
400:             "session_id": session_id,
401:             "mode":       mode,
402:             "quality":    quality,
403:         })
404:         self._class_counts[label] = self._class_counts.get(label, 0) + 1
405:         self._last_rec = now
406: 
407:         if not self.class_balance_ok:
408:             print(f"[gesture_learner] Class imbalance warning: {self._class_counts}")
409:         return True
410: 
411:     def clear(self) -> None:
412:         self.recordings.clear()
413:         self._class_counts = {d: 0 for d in IntentLabeler.DIRECTIONS}

418: class GestureDataset:
419:     """Persists versioned gesture recordings as JSON session files."""
420: 
421:     def __init__(self, data_dir: Path = DATA_DIR):
422:         self.SESSION_DIR = data_dir / "sessions"
423: 
424:     def save_session(self, recordings: List[Dict]) -> Optional[Path]:
425:         if not recordings:
426:             return None
427:         self.SESSION_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
428:         ts   = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
429:         path = self.SESSION_DIR / f"session_{ts}.json"
430:         with open(path, "w") as f:
431:             json.dump(recordings, f)
432:         print(f"[gesture_learner] Saved {len(recordings)} recordings → {path.name}")
433:         return path

435:     def as_xy(self) -> Tuple[List[List[float]], List[str]]:
436:         """Load all saved sessions, return (X, y). Skips schema-incompatible records."""
437:         X, y, _ = self.as_xy_with_sessions()
438:         return X, y
439: 
440:     def as_xy_with_sessions(
441:         self,
442:     ) -> Tuple[List[List[float]], List[str], List[str]]:
443:         """
444:         Load all sessions, return (X, y, session_ids).
445:         session_ids[i] identifies which recording session sample i came from,
446:         enabling session-aware train/test splitting in cross-validation.
447:         Skips records whose feature vector length differs from N_FEATURES.
448:         """
449:         X:           List[List[float]] = []
450:         y:           List[str]         = []
451:         session_ids: List[str]         = []
452:         expected = FeatureExtractor.N_FEATURES
453:         skipped  = 0
454: 
455:         if not self.SESSION_DIR.exists():
456:             return X, y, session_ids
457: 
458:         for fp in sorted(self.SESSION_DIR.glob("session_*.json")):
459:             session_name = fp.stem
460:             try:
461:                 recs = json.loads(fp.read_text())
462:                 for r in recs:
463:                     feats = r.get("features", [])
464:                     label = r.get("label", "")
465:                     if len(feats) != expected or not label:
466:                         skipped += 1
467:                         continue
468:                     X.append(feats)
469:                     y.append(label)
470:                     session_ids.append(r.get("session_id") or session_name)
471:             except Exception as exc:
472:                 print(f"[gesture_learner] Could not load {fp.name}: {exc}")
473: 
474:         if skipped > 0:
475:             print(
476:                 f"[gesture_learner] Skipped {skipped} records with incompatible feature "
477:                 f"count (expected {expected}). Collect new data to rebuild."
478:             )
479:         return X, y, session_ids

484: class GestureModel:
485:     """Probabilistic RandomForest with calibrated confidence and abstain support."""
486: 
487:     def __init__(self, data_dir: Path = DATA_DIR, confidence_threshold: float = 0.55):
488:         self.MODEL_PATH           = data_dir / "model.pkl"
489:         self._clf                 = None
490:         self.confidence_threshold = confidence_threshold
491: 
492:     @property
493:     def ready(self) -> bool:
494:         return self._clf is not None and SKLEARN_AVAILABLE
495: 
496:     def set_confidence_threshold(self, threshold: float) -> None:
497:         self.confidence_threshold = threshold
498: 
499:     def train(self, X: List[List[float]], y: List[str]) -> bool:
500:         if not SKLEARN_AVAILABLE:
501:             print("[gesture_learner] scikit-learn not available — cannot train.")
502:             return False
503:         if len(X) < MIN_TRAIN_SAMPLES:
504:             return False
505:         try:
506:             clf = RandomForestClassifier(
507:                 n_estimators=60, max_depth=8,
508:                 class_weight="balanced", random_state=42,
509:             )
510:             clf.fit(X, y)
511:             self._clf = clf
512:             self._save()
513:             return True
514:         except Exception as exc:
515:             print(f"[gesture_learner] Training failed: {exc}")
516:             return False
517: 
518:     def predict_with_confidence(
519:         self, features: List[float],
520:     ) -> Tuple[Optional[str], float]:
521:         """
522:         Returns (direction, confidence) or (None, confidence) to abstain.
523:         Abstains when confidence is below threshold or sklearn unavailable.
524:         """
525:         if self._clf is None or not SKLEARN_AVAILABLE:
526:             return None, 0.0
527:         try:
528:             proba    = self._clf.predict_proba([features])[0]
529:             best_idx = int(max(range(len(proba)), key=lambda i: proba[i]))
530:             conf     = float(proba[best_idx])
531:             if conf < self.confidence_threshold:
532:                 return None, conf
533:             return str(self._clf.classes_[best_idx]), conf
534:         except Exception:
535:             return None, 0.0
536: 
537:     def predict(self, features: List[float]) -> Optional[str]:
538:         direction, _ = self.predict_with_confidence(features)
539:         return direction
540: 
541:     def _save(self) -> None:
542:         self.MODEL_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
543:         try:
544:             import pickle
545:             with open(self.MODEL_PATH, "wb") as f:
546:                 pickle.dump(self._clf, f)
547:         except Exception as exc:
548:             print(f"[gesture_learner] Save failed: {exc}")
549: 
550:     def load(self) -> bool:
551:         if not self.MODEL_PATH.exists():
552:             return False
553:         try:
554:             import pickle
555:             with open(self.MODEL_PATH, "rb") as f:
556:                 clf = pickle.load(f)
557:             # Discard model if feature count no longer matches extractor
558:             expected = FeatureExtractor.N_FEATURES
559:             if hasattr(clf, 'n_features_in_') and clf.n_features_in_ != expected:
560:                 print(
561:                     f"[gesture_learner] Saved model has {clf.n_features_in_} features, "
562:                     f"need {expected} — discarding. Press L to collect new data."
563:                 )
564:                 return False
565:             self._clf = clf
566:             print("[gesture_learner] Loaded existing model.")
567:             return True
568:         except Exception as exc:
569:             print(f"[gesture_learner] Load failed: {exc}")
570:             return False

594: class GestureValidator:
595:     """
596:     Session-aware stratified k-fold cross-validation.
597: 
598:     Critical invariant: all samples from the same recording session are assigned
599:     to the same fold, preventing leakage from temporally-correlated samples.
600:     Reports precision, recall, F1, FP rate, abstain rate, and latency estimate.
601:     """
602: 
603:     def __init__(self, dataset: "GestureDataset", n_folds: int = 5):
604:         self._dataset = dataset
605:         self._n_folds = n_folds
606:         self.result: Optional[ValidationResult] = None
607:         self._running = False
608:         self._thread: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
609: 
610:     @property
611:     def running(self) -> bool:
612:         return self._running
613: 
614:     def start(self) -> None:
615:         if self._running:
616:             return
617:         self._running = True
618:         self.result   = None
619:         self._thread  = threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True)
620:         self._thread.start()
621: 
622:     def _run(self) -> None:
623:         try:
624:             self.result = self._validate()

"""
games/scratch_pad/game.py — Scratch Pad to test gesture data

Draw lines, flip (flick) to toggle pen on/off, change colors,
and display matched gesture predictions from ML data.
"""

import math
import random
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List, Optional, Tuple

import pygame

from shared.gesture_learner import GestureLearningSystem, IMUSnapshot
from shared.learn_test_support import draw_gesture_debug_overlay

# ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 800, 600
FPS = 60

# ── Colors ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG = (15, 15, 25)
TEXT_CLR = (255, 255, 255)
DIM_CLR = (180, 180, 200)

PALETTE = [
    (255, 100, 100), (100, 255, 100), (100, 100, 255),
    (255, 255, 100), (255, 100, 255), (100, 255, 255),
    (255, 165, 0), (200, 150, 255)
]

@dataclass
class LineSegment:
    points: List[Tuple[float, float]]
    color: Tuple[int, int, int]


class ScratchPadGame:
    def __init__(self, screen, clock, debug=False, mode="standard", audio=None, username=""):
        self._screen = screen
        self._clock = clock
        self._debug = debug
        self._mode = mode
        self._audio = audio
        self._username = username
        self._gesture_src = None
        
        self._learning_system = GestureLearningSystem(username=username)

        self._init_layout(screen)
        self._reset()

    def _init_layout(self, screen):
        self._screen = screen
        self._W, self._H = screen.get_size()
        sc = min(self._W / W, self._H / H)
        self._sc = sc
        self._is_fullscreen = not (self._W == W and self._H == H)

        self._font_lg = pygame.font.SysFont("monospace", max(24, int(48 * sc)), bold=True)
        self._font_md = pygame.font.SysFont("monospace", max(16, int(28 * sc)), bold=True)
        self._font_sm = pygame.font.SysFont("monospace", max(10, int(16 * sc)))

    def _reset(self):
        self._cursor_x = self._W // 2
        self._cursor_y = self._H // 2
        self._pen_down = False
        self._lines: List[LineSegment] = []
        self._current_color = PALETTE[0]
        self._predicted_gesture = ""
        self._prediction_timer = 0.0

    def run(self, gesture_src):
        self._gesture_src = gesture_src
        self._reset()
        pygame.mouse.set_visible(False)
        if self._audio:
            self._audio.start_background()

        while True:
            dt = self._clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0
            result = self._handle_events()
            if result:
                if self._audio: self._audio.stop_background()
                return result
            self._update(dt)
            self._draw()
            pygame.display.flip()

    def _handle_events(self):
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                return "quit"
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                    return "home"
                if event.key == pygame.K_f:
                    self._toggle_fullscreen()
                if event.key == pygame.K_d:
                    self._debug = not self._debug
                if event.key == pygame.K_c:
                    self._lines.clear()
        return None

    def _toggle_fullscreen(self):
        self._is_fullscreen = not self._is_fullscreen
        new_screen = pygame.display.set_mode((0, 0) if self._is_fullscreen else (W, H), pygame.FULLSCREEN if self._is_fullscreen else 0)
        self._init_layout(new_screen)

    def _update(self, dt):
        if self._prediction_timer > 0:
            self._prediction_timer -= dt

        gs = self._gesture_src.get_state() if self._gesture_src else None
        if gs and gs.calibrated:
            # Reconstruct IMUSnapshot and feed learning system
            snap = IMUSnapshot(
                t=time.monotonic(),
                gx=gs.abs_gx, gy=gs.abs_gy, gz=gs.abs_gz,
                ax=gs.abs_ax, ay=gs.abs_ay, az=gs.abs_az,
                euler_roll=gs.euler_roll, euler_pitch=gs.euler_pitch
            )
            self._learning_system.buffer.push(snap)
            
            # Make predictions periodically if we have enough buffer
            window = self._learning_system.buffer.snapshot()
            features = self._learning_system.extractor.extract(window)
            if features:
                direction, conf = self._learning_system.model.predict_with_confidence(features)
                if direction and conf >= self._learning_system.model.confidence_threshold:
                    self._predicted_gesture = f"{direction.upper()} ({conf*100:.0f}%)"
                    self._prediction_timer = 2.0  # display for 2 seconds

            # Map Euler angles directly to screen position for drawing
            max_angle = 30.0
            roll = max(-max_angle, min(max_angle, gs.euler_roll))
            pitch = max(-max_angle, min(max_angle, gs.euler_pitch))

            self._cursor_x = self._W * (roll + max_angle) / (2 * max_angle)
            self._cursor_y = self._H * (pitch + max_angle) / (2 * max_angle)

            # Check for flick to toggle pen
            if gs.launch:
                self._pen_down = not self._pen_down
                if self._pen_down:
                    self._current_color = random.choice(PALETTE)
                    self._lines.append(LineSegment(points=[], color=self._current_color))
                    if self._audio: self._audio.play_flick_cast()
                else:
                    if self._audio: self._audio.play_collect()

            # Add points to active line
            if self._pen_down:
                if not self._lines:
                    self._lines.append(LineSegment(points=[], color=self._current_color))
                
                last_line = self._lines[-1]
                # Avoid adding points if too close to previous point to smooth drawing
                if not last_line.points or math.hypot(self._cursor_x - last_line.points[-1][0], self._cursor_y - last_line.points[-1][1]) > 5 * self._sc:
                    last_line.points.append((self._cursor_x, self._cursor_y))

    def _draw(self):
        self._screen.fill(BG)

        # Draw lines
        for line in self._lines:
            if len(line.points) > 1:
                pygame.draw.lines(self._screen, line.color, False, line.points, int(4 * self._sc))
            elif len(line.points) == 1:
                pygame.draw.circle(self._screen, line.color, (int(line.points[0][0]), int(line.points[0][1])), int(4 * self._sc))

        # Draw cursor
        cursor_color = self._current_color if self._pen_down else (100, 100, 100)
        pygame.draw.circle(self._screen, cursor_color, (int(self._cursor_x), int(self._cursor_y)), int(10 * self._sc))
        if not self._pen_down:
            pygame.draw.circle(self._screen, (50, 50, 50), (int(self._cursor_x), int(self._cursor_y)), int(8 * self._sc))

        # Draw UI
        self._draw_ui()

        if self._debug and self._gesture_src:
            draw_gesture_debug_overlay(self._screen, self._gesture_src.get_state(), self._W, self._H, self._sc, self._font_sm)

    def _draw_ui(self):
        sc = self._sc
        title = self._font_md.render("Scratch Pad", True, TEXT_CLR)

"""
games/scratch_pad/game.py — Scratch Pad to test gesture data

Draw lines, flip (flick) to toggle pen on/off, change colors,
and display matched gesture predictions from ML data.
"""

import math
import random
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List, Optional, Tuple

import pygame

from shared.gesture_learner import GestureLearningSystem, IMUSnapshot
from shared.learn_test_support import draw_gesture_debug_overlay

# ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 800, 600
FPS = 60

# ── Colors ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG = (15, 15, 25)
TEXT_CLR = (255, 255, 255)
DIM_CLR = (180, 180, 200)

PALETTE = [
    (255, 100, 100), (100, 255, 100), (100, 100, 255),
    (255, 255, 100), (255, 100, 255), (100, 255, 255),
    (255, 165, 0), (200, 150, 255)
]

@dataclass
class LineSegment:
    points: List[Tuple[float, float]]
    color: Tuple[int, int, int]


class ScratchPadGame:
    def __init__(self, screen, clock, debug=False, mode="standard", audio=None, username=""):
        self._screen = screen
        self._clock = clock
        self._debug = debug
        self._mode = mode
        self._audio = audio
        self._username = username
        self._gesture_src = None
        
        self._learning_system = GestureLearningSystem(username=username)

        self._init_layout(screen)
        self._reset()

    def _init_layout(self, screen):
        self._screen = screen
        self._W, self._H = screen.get_size()
        sc = min(self._W / W, self._H / H)
        self._sc = sc
        self._is_fullscreen = not (self._W == W and self._H == H)

        self._font_lg = pygame.font.SysFont("monospace", max(24, int(48 * sc)), bold=True)
        self._font_md = pygame.font.SysFont("monospace", max(16, int(28 * sc)), bold=True)
        self._font_sm = pygame.font.SysFont("monospace", max(10, int(16 * sc)))

    def _reset(self):
        self._cursor_x = self._W // 2
        self._cursor_y = self._H // 2
        self._pen_down = False
        self._lines: List[LineSegment] = []
        self._current_color = PALETTE[0]
        self._predicted_gesture = ""
        self._prediction_timer = 0.0

    def run(self, gesture_src):
        self._gesture_src = gesture_src
        self._reset()
        pygame.mouse.set_visible(False)
        if self._audio:
            self._audio.start_background()

        while True:
            dt = self._clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0
            result = self._handle_events()
            if result:
                if self._audio: self._audio.stop_background()
                return result
            self._update(dt)
            self._draw()
            pygame.display.flip()

    def _handle_events(self):
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                return "quit"
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                    return "home"
                if event.key == pygame.K_f:
                    self._toggle_fullscreen()
                if event.key == pygame.K_d:
                    self._debug = not self._debug
                if event.key == pygame.K_c:
                    self._lines.clear()
        return None

    def _toggle_fullscreen(self):
        self._is_fullscreen = not self._is_fullscreen
        new_screen = pygame.display.set_mode((0, 0) if self._is_fullscreen else (W, H), pygame.FULLSCREEN if self._is_fullscreen else 0)
        self._init_layout(new_screen)

    def _update(self, dt):
        if self._prediction_timer > 0:
            self._prediction_timer -= dt

        gs = self._gesture_src.get_state() if self._gesture_src else None
        if gs and gs.calibrated:
            # Reconstruct IMUSnapshot and feed learning system
            snap = IMUSnapshot(
                t=time.monotonic(),
                gx=gs.abs_gx, gy=gs.abs_gy, gz=gs.abs_gz,
                ax=gs.abs_ax, ay=gs.abs_ay, az=gs.abs_az,
                euler_roll=gs.euler_roll, euler_pitch=gs.euler_pitch
            )
            self._learning_system.buffer.push(snap)
            
            # Make predictions periodically if we have enough buffer
            window = self._learning_system.buffer.snapshot()
            features = self._learning_system.extractor.extract(window)
            if features:
                direction, conf = self._learning_system.model.predict_with_confidence(features)
                if direction and conf >= self._learning_system.model.confidence_threshold:
                    self._predicted_gesture = f"{direction.upper()} ({conf*100:.0f}%)"
                    self._prediction_timer = 2.0  # display for 2 seconds

            # Map Euler angles directly to screen position for drawing
            max_angle = 30.0
            roll = max(-max_angle, min(max_angle, gs.euler_roll))
            pitch = max(-max_angle, min(max_angle, gs.euler_pitch))

            self._cursor_x = self._W * (roll + max_angle) / (2 * max_angle)
            self._cursor_y = self._H * (pitch + max_angle) / (2 * max_angle)

            # Check for flick to toggle pen
            if gs.launch:
                self._pen_down = not self._pen_down
                if self._pen_down:
                    self._current_color = random.choice(PALETTE)
                    self._lines.append(LineSegment(points=[], color=self._current_color))
                    if self._audio: self._audio.play_flick_cast()
                else:
                    if self._audio: self._audio.play_collect()

            # Add points to active line
            if self._pen_down:
                if not self._lines:
                    self._lines.append(LineSegment(points=[], color=self._current_color))
                
                last_line = self._lines[-1]
                # Avoid adding points if too close to previous point to smooth drawing
                if not last_line.points or math.hypot(self._cursor_x - last_line.points[-1][0], self._cursor_y - last_line.points[-1][1]) > 5 * self._sc:
                    last_line.points.append((self._cursor_x, self._cursor_y))

    def _draw(self):
        self._screen.fill(BG)

        # Draw lines
        for line in self._lines:
            if len(line.points) > 1:
                pygame.draw.lines(self._screen, line.color, False, line.points, int(4 * self._sc))
            elif len(line.points) == 1:
                pygame.draw.circle(self._screen, line.color, (int(line.points[0][0]), int(line.points[0][1])), int(4 * self._sc))

        # Draw cursor
        cursor_color = self._current_color if self._pen_down else (100, 100, 100)
        pygame.draw.circle(self._screen, cursor_color, (int(self._cursor_x), int(self._cursor_y)), int(10 * self._sc))
        if not self._pen_down:
            pygame.draw.circle(self._screen, (50, 50, 50), (int(self._cursor_x), int(self._cursor_y)), int(8 * self._sc))

        # Draw UI
        self._draw_ui()

        if self._debug and self._gesture_src:
            draw_gesture_debug_overlay(self._screen, self._gesture_src.get_state(), self._W, self._H, self._sc, self._font_sm)

    def _draw_ui(self):
        sc = self._sc
        title = self._font_md.render("Scratch Pad", True, TEXT_CLR)
        self._screen.blit(title, (int(20 * sc), int(20 * sc)))
        
        status = "PEN: ON" if self._pen_down else "PEN: OFF"
        status_surf = self._font_sm.render(status, True, self._current_color if self._pen_down else DIM_CLR)
        self._screen.blit(status_surf, (int(20 * sc), int(50 * sc)))

        inst = self._font_sm.render("Tilt to move  •  Flick UP to toggle pen  •  C to clear", True, DIM_CLR)
        self._screen.blit(inst, (int(20 * sc), self._H - int(30 * sc)))

        if self._prediction_timer > 0 and self._predicted_gesture:
            pred_surf = self._font_lg.render(f"Gesture: {self._predicted_gesture}", True, (255, 200, 100))
            self._screen.blit(pred_surf, pred_surf.get_rect(center=(self._W // 2, int(80 * sc))))
